text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Physiological Jaundice of the Newborn. The clinical picture of yellowing appearing after birth, combined with negative findings for blood incompatibility and a normal abdominal ultrasound, confirms this common, benign condition rather than pathological causes like hemolysis or biliary atresia.
